correctness.rationale: For phi(0)=001, phi(1)=011, W_k=phi^k(0), m=3^(k-1), the AAB decomposition with A/B differing at their exact central position creates four repeated-factor intervals. Their increasing endpoints cover all positions, and the bridge lemma forces any unique factor to contain one of three bridges. The substitutions have disjoint start-modulo-three factor patterns, so trimmed-image occurrence bijections preserve uniqueness inductively; each bridge has repeated proper prefix/suffix. Independent direct occurrence counting on W_k for k=2,3,4 produced exactly the predicted three (start,length) pairs: k2 (2,3),(5,3),(7,2); k3 (8,6),(16,7),(22,4); k4 (26,15),(49,19),(67,10). This finite check corroborates, not replaces, universal bridge induction.
